title: Summer 2027 Cybersecurity Internship (Offensive Cyber Operations & Mobile Vulnerability Research)
description:
Location: Chantilly, VA

At REDLattice, we are a global leader in delivering cutting-edge technical cybersecurity products and services. As we grow and adapt in an increasingly complex digital environment,

We are driven by mission-critical and innovative work that directly contributes to protecting our nation’s and strategic partners’ most vital infrastructure. Our teams lead advanced vulnerability analysis and develop tailored cyber solutions to meet the demands of rapidly evolving mission space. With offices in Northern Virginia, Melbourne, Florida, Tel Aviv, Israel, and other strategic locations, REDLattice is growing rapidly to meet the evolving needs of our customers.

REDLattice is seeking motivated and innovative college students to join our Cybersecurity Internship (Offensive Cyber Operations & Mobile Vulnerability Research) for the summer of 2027. As a member of our Cyber Internship program, your work will directly support real customer requirements and mission impact, from day one. Over the summer, you’ll contribute to the development of modern Computer Network Operations (CNO) tools and capabilities, helping create new access to today’s most advanced mobile devices. You’ll go deep into the cutting edge of device instrumentation, exploit mitigations, and modern research methodologies, tackling some of the hardest reverse engineering targets in the field. Along the way, you’ll be guided and mentored by leading researchers who will help shape the direction of your work and ensure you leave feeling challenged, supported, and fulfilled.

Responsibilities

Solve challenging security problems through vulnerability research and software development.
Conduct reverse engineering, vulnerability analysis, and exploit development for mobile and embedded systems.
Collaborate in small teams or independently to develop offensive cybersecurity tools and methodologies.
Low-level system and operating system development and research.
Support and enhance existing codebases and contribute to the development of new projects.

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Previous coursework and/or experience in reverse engineering with modern tools (Ghidra, Binary ninja, gdb, etc.)
Strong work ethic, eager to learn, and a positive attitude.
Must be eligible to receive US Security Clearance.

Desired Skills

Rising junior or senior preferred.
Proficiency in C, C++, Python, and Assembly languages.
Familiarity with Git and modern software engineering practices.
Basic knowledge of mobile security, embedded systems, and network protocols is a plus.
A passion for learning about cutting-edge offensive cyber techniques and tools.

We look forward to helping you grow your skills in offensive cyber operations while contributing to real-world projects that protect the nation's digital landscape.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

REDLattice is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law.

Join us at REDLattice and be a part of a team that is at the forefront of cyber innovation and security. Apply today!
